corpuses.description: A bounded ~24,000-fact slice of Princeton WordNet / Open English WordNet, prioritizing the hypernym (IsA) backbone and synonym chains for the most commonly-referenced synsets. Mechanically derived from Open English WordNet (CC-BY-4.0).

The complete ConceptNet-shape conversion of Princeton WordNet / Open English WordNet's structural relations (hypernym, meronymy, causes, attribute, similar, also) plus member-synonym chains. Derived from Open English WordNet (CC-BY-4.0).
